jobs.title: Growth Product Manager, Guest
jobs.jd_full:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) - EST preferred

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

About the Role

Toast IQ Grow is an all-in-one growth and lifecycle solution designed to help restaurants attract more guests, keep them coming back, and increase revenue without adding extra work for operators. Delivering this value involves a complex mix of product, systems, operations and more.

The IQ Grow Flex team owns the top of the Toast IQ Grow funnel - everything from sale close to first campaign. We’re building the AI-powered context, onboarding and activation layer that compresses time-to-value, captures restaurant context and removes human bottlenecks from the path to go-live.

This is a growth PM role. You’ll start deep in onboarding, but the mandate is broader: find the leverage points across Guest products where product investment can drive direct business impact at scale.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Drive business growth, however you see fit: the mandate is outcome-oriented, but the tactics are up to the PM. Come in, identify and pursue the next high-impact bets.
  • Own restaurant context: Build tools that help Marketing Managers and AI Agents capture, synthesize, and act on restaurant context faster.
  • Drive onboarding efficiency: Reduce human dependency and compress time-to-live through product.
  • Drive activation and product value: Own the metrics that matter: time-to-first-campaign, feature adoption rates, and early retention signals. Identify what drives sustained usage, instrument the funnel, and partner with internal teams to experiment.

What you’ll work with

  • A fast-moving team with a flexible growth mindset
  • Cross-functional enthusiasm: support and collaboration from a variety of stakeholders
  • AI-native product development: agents, LLMs, structured knowledge stores
  • High visibility and impact: IQ Grow is the fastest growing product in the history of Toast

What you’ll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 3+ years in product management, ideally with experience in a growth environment
  • Comfort with ambiguity: this is a new team with a big mandate and room to shape direction
  • Strong cross-functional instincts: you’ll work across eng, design, ops, onboarding and multiple product teams
  • Interest in AI/agentic products: you don’t need to be an expert, but you should be curious
  • Bias to ship: we move fast and learn from live products

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we’re hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

#LI-REMOTE

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.jd_full:
Position Summary:

The Product Analyst is a data-driven and detail-oriented professional responsible for supporting the analysis, maintenance, and enhancement of healthcare data products.

The role combines US healthcare claims data analysis, product validation, requirements documentation, dashboard development, and cross-functional collaboration. The ideal candidate will have strong problem-solving abilities and hands-on experience using SQL, Power BI, and Excel to analyze complex datasets, investigate issues, assess business impact, and generate actionable insights.

The Product Analyst will work closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Engagement, and Account teams. This role will report to Product Owner.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Represents the Product team on all active projects.
  • Participates in the daily application operations / development stand-up meetings.
  • Supports data delivery for the clients subscribed to the product.
  • Work closely with team and stakeholders to develop and deliver high-quality data products.
  • Analyze large US healthcare claims datasets to identify patterns, data-quality issues, coverage gaps, and product-improvement opportunities.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, profiling, reconciliation, validation, and impact analysis.
  • Compare datasets and product outputs to assess the impact of source changes, revised business rules, data-period changes, and product enhancements.
  • Investigate complex data and product issues, perform root-cause analysis, assess business impact, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Analyze medical claims, pharmacy claims, prescription, payer, formulary, and patient-level data across patient, claim, payer, plan, and other relevant levels.
  • Support the validation of product outputs, analytical processes, data transformations, and machine-learning-generated results.
  • Create and maintain product documentation, including data dictionaries, business rules, requirements, test scenarios, and validation results.
  • Support functional testing, data validation, regression testing, defect investigation, and user acceptance testing.
  • Support feasibility assessments and proof-of-concept initiatives for new healthcare data and analytics capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (B.E.) or in Technology (B. Tech.). Degree in computer science or related fields preferred.

Minimum Required

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in healthcare analytics, product analysis, business analysis, data analysis, or a related role.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous business questions, investigate data discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and recommend actionable solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL, Power BI, and Microsoft Excel.
  • Hands-on experience analyzing US healthcare data, with exposure to one or more of the following datasets, data sources, or equivalent healthcare datasets:
  • Medical, pharmacy claims, and patient-level data, such as McKesson Compile, Symphony PatientSource, Komodo Health or equivalent sources.
  • Formulary and market-access data, such as MMIT, DRG Fingertip, or equivalent sources.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake.
  • Understanding of medical and pharmacy claims, payer hierarchies, BIN-PCN-Group data, formulary data, market access, or patient-services analytics.
  • Exposure to longitudinal patient analysis, treatment patterns, patient journeys, or payer-access analytics.
  • Familiarity with Python, APIs, JSON, or machine-learning output validation.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or Agile product-development practices.
  • Working knowledge of US Healthcare / Market Access would be an advantage.
  • Experience developing in HIPAA compliant ecosystem.

Other Required:

  • May require travel domestically and/or internationally including overnight stays up to 5%.

Competencies:

  • Communication Skills: Written, Verbal, and Presentation: The successful candidate must have the ability to read, analyze, and interpret production data, financial reports, and legal documents. Excellent verbal, written, presentation, interpersonal skills including ability to clearly respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, employees, and members of the business community. Must possess a rapid agility to reply to emails, provide instructions of work stream necessities or issues encountered, business and report writings in a succinct and informative manner.
  • Business Judgment and Strategic Thinking: Ability to think, act, and deliver value in the best interest of our clients with respect to common practices of the healthcare consulting field. Ability to extrapolate from the specific to the general and interpret from the general to the specific.
  • Analytic Skills: Framing macro problems into action steps or work plans for resolutions. Structuring a persuasive client presentation based on in-depth or expansive excel spreadsheets. Demonstrable interpretive and solution identification skills with the ability to understand multiple types of quantitative and qualitative data heightened with strong resolution skills.
  • Collaboration and Teamwork: Ability to give and receive constructive feedback and work effectively across the organization to accomplish team goals is critical. The successful candidate must possess excellent judgment, management, and conflict resolution skills. Ability to work with team members to convey results, incorporate enhancements and productionize processes across projects. Must be able to understand the dynamics of how a team interconnects and relies upon every member.
  • Strategic Thinking: Conceptualize outside of the aspects of a project at hand, with an ability to visualize how the work contributes to and drives forward the overall project.
  • Solutions oriented: must be able to display resourcefulness and confidence under pressure.
  • Resilience: must be able to look past obstacles and roadblocks, ask questions and for support, and find their way around any obstacle.

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Project Manager-Wet Utilities (Hybrid Work Possibility)
jobs.jd_full:
About the Company

Our client is a multi-generational, family-owned heavy civil contractor specializing in grading and wet utility construction throughout Southern California. The company self-performs the majority of its work and partners with general contractors on public, private, and federal projects.

With a lean, open-shop team and a strong, values-driven culture, the company emphasizes safety, technical excellence, and long-term relationships. Its leadership team is highly tenured, and regular company-wide safety and skills training reinforce its commitment to doing quality work and earning repeat business.

About the Position

Our client is seeking an experienced Project Manager – Wet Utilities to oversee multiple grading and wet utility projects from contract execution through final closeout. This individual will take ownership of project profitability, accuracy, and client relationships while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

The position will manage approximately $6–8 million in combined project backlog, with a target gross profit margin of 28% or higher.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Negotiate and administer contracts with clients, subcontractors, and vendors in coordination with the President.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects, maintaining profitability, schedule performance, and budget targets.
  • Partner with Superintendents and Foremen to ensure work meets plans, specifications, safety requirements, and project KPIs.
  • Lead change management, including pricing and timely billing of change orders.
  • Oversee accurate project billing, WIP reporting, and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Develop and monitor project budgets, prepare monthly Cost at Completion reports, and approve weekly job cost invoices.
  • Review daily field reports for cost code accuracy, budget performance, and schedule progress.
  • Conduct weekly job cost reviews with Superintendents and Foremen.
  • Participate in project turnover meetings and thoroughly understand contract terms, scope, plans, specifications, exclusions, and estimator agreements.
  • Coordinate procurement and ordering of long-lead materials and equipment.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, including submittals, RFIs, change orders, meeting minutes, QC/QA reports, as-builts, and closeout packages.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop Project Engineers.
  • Identify, understand, and manage project risks while protecting the interests of all parties involved.
  • Work within an established escalation structure, collaborating with the Director of Project Management and Director of Field Operations, with access to the President when needed.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Project Manager with a heavy civil subcontractor or specialty contractor. General contractor/prime contractor backgrounds alone will not be considered.
  • Strong knowledge of wet utilities, particularly water, sewer, and storm drain construction.
  • Grading, earthwork, and site development experience is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience negotiating contracts and taking ownership of project gross profit margins.
  • Strong financial management skills, including job costing, WIP reporting, billing, budgeting, and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and overseeing combined backlogs.
  • Ability to mentor and develop Project Engineers.
  • Experience with projects involving military, K–12 and higher education, pharmaceutical/laboratory commercial, and high-density residential construction is beneficial.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to maintain firm positions while working collaboratively.
  • Ability to manage projects throughout Temecula and San Diego County.
  • Candidates based in Temecula Valley, Murrieta, or the Inland Empire are preferred.
  • Hybrid arrangements involving 2–3 office days per week may be considered for the right candidate.

Benefits

  • Base salary of $140,000–$160,000, depending on experience.
  • Annual profit-based bonus opportunity of up to approximately $10,000.
  • Medical insurance coverage for employees.
  • Two weeks of paid time off, with three weeks negotiable.
  • Six paid holidays.
  • Opportunity to join a family-owned organization with long-tenured leadership and a relationship-driven culture.

A strong understanding of how Security Systems organizations function within large global enterprises is important for success in this role.   • Manage multiple projects and initiatives by developing project plans, timelines, milestones, and tracking deliverables.

  • Develop and maintain documentation that clearly defines roles, responsibilities, and workflows for internal teams, external partners, and vendors to ensure alignment and successful project execution.

jobs.title: Senior Partner Delivery Manager (UK)
jobs.jd_full:
About Parloa

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Sr Partner Delivery Manager, you will own and scale strategic relationships with Parloa’s global SI, consulting, and implementation partners, ensuring they can deliver transformative AI and customer experience solutions for enterprise customers.

This is your opportunity to shape how enterprise partners adopt, scale, and operationalize agentic AI, helping define Partner Success at one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world.

Areas of ownership:

  • Partner Relationship Management: Own a portfolio of strategic Parloa partners, building trusted relationships with partner executives, practice leads, delivery managers, architects, and customer stakeholders.
  • Practice Advisory: Act as strategic advisor to partners on building and scaling their Parloa services practice, covering delivery methodologies, organizational structure, certifications, and go-to-market motions.
  • Delivery Oversight: Guide partners through complex enterprise AI and CX transformation programs, monitor partner-led implementations, and proactively manage risks and escalations to drive successful outcomes.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Account Executives and Partner Managers on strategic deals, and ensure close alignment between partners and internal teams across Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, and Solution Engineering.
  • Program Operations: Drive operational rigor through governance structures, success metrics, delivery reviews, and executive business reviews, while helping scale Partner Success programs, playbooks, and frameworks.

Who you are:

  • 6+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS, consulting, partner management, customer success, or professional services
  • Proven track record working with global systems integrators, consulting firms, or implementation partners to drive measurable customer outcomes
  • Strong understanding of enterprise delivery models, implementation methodologies (SAFe Agile, waterfall), and project governance
  • Strong executive presence, able to lead executive reviews and communicate confidently with partner leadership, customer executives, and technical teams
  • Excellent written and spoken English is required

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We’re at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn’t just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We’re building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren’t just support tickets; they’re defining experiences. We’re here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn’t a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that’s evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We’ve grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we’ve kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we’re scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients’ and employees’ data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. Please click here to learn more.

jobs.title: Project Manager III (Radiology)
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

At Intelerad, we believe the path to answers in healthcare should be clear-whether you are waiting for a diagnosis or trying to expedite one. Our medical imaging solutions streamline the flow of information, simplifying complex processes, maximizing efficiencies, and shining a light on the unknown. We empower physicians to get patients the answers they need faster and improve outcomes for everyone. With more accessible imaging, we are getting patients out of the dark.

Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 800 employees located in offices across four countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. Intelerad’s modern enterprise solutions have been acknowledged by a Best in KLAS recognition, ranking #1 for PACS Europe UK/Ireland in the 2026 Best in KLAS: Global Software (Non-US) report.

Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager III to lead successful delivery of medium-to-large-scale healthcare IT implementations for radiology and cardiology imaging solutions. This role requires strong project management expertise combined with the ability to navigate complex customer environments, coordinate cross-functional teams, and ensure on-time, on-budget project completion. The ideal candidate brings proven experience managing multiple concurrent implementations, mentoring junior team members, and building trusted advisor relationships with healthcare provider clients. This position plays a critical role in ensuring customers realize the full value of Intelerad’s medical imaging platforms throughout their implementation journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project planning, execution, and delivery for medium to large-scale healthcare IT implementations, managing project scope, timeline, budget, and resource allocation to ensure successful outcomes that meet customer requirements and business objectives.
  • Serve as primary customer contact and trusted advisor throughout project lifecycle, proactively identifying and resolving issues, managing escalations cross-functionally, and maintaining transparent communication with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.
  • Coordinate Professional Services resources across implementation teams, create and maintain comprehensive project documentation including plans, status reports, and meeting minutes, and ensure all deliverables meet quality standards and established timelines.
  • Mentor Project Manager I and II team members, providing guidance on best practices, escalation management, and customer relationship development to build team capability and ensure consistent delivery excellence across the PMO organization.
  • Lead internal transformation and standardization initiatives under PMO leadership direction, contributing to continuous improvement programs that enhance delivery methodology, tools, and team performance across Professional Services.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in project management roles, with demonstrated success leading medium to largescale technology implementations
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, prioritize competing demands, and deliver results within timeline and budget constraints

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience managing healthcare IT projects or working in healthcare provider environments strongly preferred
  • Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Belt certification
  • Experience with radiology or cardiology healthcare IT solutions such as PACS, RIS, or enterprise imaging platforms
  • Experience managing projects in North American healthcare setting
  • Skills in cloud architecture and networking a major advantage, AWS preferred
  • CAPM or PMP certification

Travel Requirements • This position requires up to 25% travel, primarily throughout North America

This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Applicants may be required to complete an online personality assessment as part of your application.
